name: Primary Treasury
description: Read-only MCP server for querying Primary financial data, including balances, transaction history, FX rates, accounts, and treasury reporting. No write, transfer initiation, or state-changing operations are supported.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Primary Treasury to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Primary Treasury to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://papi.primary.tech/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Primary Treasury MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Primary Treasury provides these MCP tools: plan-primary-data-request and request-primary-data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Primary Treasury?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Primary Treasury in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Primary Treasury MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Primary Treasury requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Primary Treasury is developed by Primary Technology. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
